Under the 'Real estate' section, the memo lists the 118 Shore Dr, Marblehead property's value ($390,000) and explicitly cites '[documents/county-records.md]'. This satisfies the requirement to cite the county records for this property.

The deliverable attributes to the prospect only the properties and gifts that the reference files associate with David A. Miller of 412 Orchard Hill Rd. It explicitly rejects the assets and gifts belonging to the other David Millers (hits 2 and 3) and does not invent any figures.
